description: Defines the IServiceManager interface for Android's binder IPC mechanism, including methods for service registration, lookup, and management, along with related utility functions and nested structures.

classes.name: IServiceManager
classes.description: Interface for managing Android services via binder IPC, including service registration, lookup, and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: IServiceManager::ConnectionInfo
classes.description: Holds remote connection details such as IP address and port.

classes.name: IServiceManager::LocalRegistrationCallback
classes.description: Callback interface for service registration events.

classes.name: IServiceManager::ServiceDebugInfo
classes.description: Holds debugging information about services, including name and process ID.

classes.name: RpcDelegateServiceManagerOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for creating a delegated service manager, including maximum outgoing connections.

methods.name: getInterfaceDescriptor
methods.description: Returns the interface descriptor string.

methods.name: IServiceManager()
methods.description: Constructor for IServiceManager.

methods.name: ~IServiceManager()
methods.description: Destructor for IServiceManager.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Deprecated method to retrieve a service, polling for up to 5 seconds.

methods.name: checkService
methods.description: Non-blocking check for a service.

methods.name: addService
methods.description: Registers a new service with optional isolation and dump flags.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Returns a list of all registered services.

methods.name: waitForService
methods.description: Blocks until the specified service is available.

methods.name: isDeclared
methods.description: Checks if a service is declared in the VINTF manifest.

methods.name: getDeclaredInstances
methods.description: Retrieves all instances of a declared service.

methods.name: updatableViaApex
methods.description: Returns the APEX package that can update this service instance.

methods.name: getUpdatableNames
methods.description: Returns all instance names updatable via APEX.

methods.name: getConnectionInfo
methods.description: Provides remote connection info if declared.

methods.name: registerForNotifications
methods.description: Registers a callback for service registration events.

methods.name: unregisterForNotifications
methods.description: Unregisters a callback for service registration events.

methods.name: getServiceDebugInfo
methods.description: Returns debugging info for all services.

methods.name: defaultServiceManager
methods.description: Returns the default service manager instance.

methods.name: setDefaultServiceManager
methods.description: Sets the default service manager instance, mainly for testing.

methods.name: waitForService<INTERFACE>
methods.description: Template function to wait for a service and cast to interface.

methods.name: waitForDeclaredService<INTERFACE>
methods.description: Template function to wait for a declared service.

methods.name: checkDeclaredService<INTERFACE>
methods.description: Template function to check for a declared service.

methods.name: waitForVintfService<INTERFACE>
methods.description: Template function to wait for a VINTF service instance.

methods.name: checkVintfService<INTERFACE>
methods.description: Template function to check for a VINTF service instance.

methods.name: getService<INTERFACE>
methods.description: Template function to retrieve a service and output via pointer.

methods.name: checkCallingPermission
methods.description: Checks if the caller has a specific permission.

methods.name: checkPermission
methods.description: Checks if a process with given pid and uid has a permission.

methods.name: createRpcDelegateServiceManager
methods.description: Creates a service manager that delegates via ADB, for testing.
